name: medmcqa-benchmark
description: MedMCQA is a multiple-choice question benchmark of medical exam–style questions designed to evaluate models' medical knowledge and decision-making under exam conditions. It measures performance on clinically oriented MCQs spanning multiple specialties and is intended to approximate medical licensing/assessment difficulty.
reputation: A well-known medical QA benchmark used in research to test clinical knowledge of large language models, with moderate adoption in medical NLP studies.
